## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass.

### Content changes

- [ ] `npm run validate-content` passes with no errors (and no new warnings).
- [ ] References are verified, or marked `TODO: add verified reference`.
- [ ] Glossary terms are linked with `:term[…]{id="…"}` the first time they appear.
- [ ] Every new lesson or complete case study ends with at least one quiz or drill.
- [ ] New or changed figures and diagrams look right in both light and dark themes, and with reduced motion on.
